query:
WITH ['FQDN', 'FQDN-Pattern'] as target_kinds
MATCH p = (n :Namespace)-[e]->(t)-[*1..2]->()
WHERE type(e) IN ['Egress', 'EgressDeny']
AND t.primarykind IN target_kinds
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium - Egress to specific node kind (direct)
description: Direct egress (i.e., no endpoint selectors) to specific kinds (e.g., CIDR, FQDN, etc.). Modify the target_kinds array below to the desired kinds.
